Every kitchen carries the same promise: honest Indian flavours, careful preparation, and hospitality that makes every guest feel welcome. Since opening the first Mayur Indian Kitchen in Taipei in 2011, Chef Mayur has built each restaurant around its neighbourhood—bringing together regional recipes, local ingredients and the generous spirit of an Indian family table.
